limits: Nested trace slices overlap: durations must not be added.
CPU sample deltas estimate wall-clock attribution, not exclusive measured CPU time; sparse samples may span waits.
GPU service trace durations are host-side work/waits, not hardware GPU timer queries.

Window wallMs is clipped to the frame interval; cpuMsUnclipped and maxMs describe complete overlapping scopes, including time outside the interval. The initial partial frame can start at the trace anchor rather than at a prior rAF.
